tickets.title: US002: Remote Mobile Ordering
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to place and confirm my food order via my mobile phone while walking from class, so that I can bypass the standard 20-minute physical line at the cafeteria.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The user can successfully add items to a cart, confirm the order, and receive an estimated pickup time.
2. Pass/Fail: The confirmed order instantly appears on the Kitchen Display System (KDS) queue.
